constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES service_requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: service_staff_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: maintenance_state_pkey

policies.policyname: Users can read events for visible requests
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM service_requests r
  WHERE (r.id = request_events.request_id)))

policies.policyname: Staff can view the service queue
Users can create own service requests
policies.with_check: ((( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = user_id) AND (operation_key IS NOT NULL))

policies.policyname: Users can view own service requests
Staff can read the service directory

functions.identity_arguments: p_operation_key uuid, p_site text, p_system text, p_description text, p_priority text
p_request_id uuid, p_expected_version integer, p_assigned_to uuid, p_status text, p_resolution text

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER maintenance_write_gate BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON auth.users FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION private.enforce_maintenance()
CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_user()
CREATE TRIGGER maintenance_write_gate BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON public.profiles FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION private.enforce_maintenance()
CREATE TRIGGER maintenance_write_gate BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON public.request_events FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION private.enforce_maintenance()
CREATE TRIGGER check_request_version BEFORE UPDATE ON public.service_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.check_request_version()
CREATE TRIGGER maintenance_write_gate BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON public.service_requests FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION private.enforce_maintenance()
CREATE TRIGGER record_request_event AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.service_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.record_request_event()
CREATE TRIGGER validate_request_processing BEFORE UPDATE ON public.service_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.validate_request_processing()
CREATE TRIGGER maintenance_write_gate BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON public.service_staff FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION private.enforce_maintenance()

scope: Application catalog only; no user-row reads or writes, no DDL; separate catalog queries, not one transaction snapshot
